newsitem.title: USA: CBOT July soy touch down 30 cent limit on Brazil.
newsitem.headline: CBOT July soy touch down 30 cent limit on Brazil.

text.p: CBOT July soybean futures touched down the 30-cent-per-bushel trading limit in late dealings amid fast trading on news Brazil soybeans were being shipped to the U.S., traders said.

The market also was hit by follow-through technical selling after Thursday's drop in the market with a slowdown in the U.S. soy export sales pace and a slowdown in the U.S. soybean crush pace also cited.
At 1305 CST, soybeans were two to 30 cents per bushel lower, with May down 30 cents at $8.41 and July was down the 30 cent limit at $8.47.
